_comment: Kaos Zig Forge deprecation rules. Each rule fires when the target Zig version (--zig-version, default 0.16) is >= its `since`. To support a new Zig release, add rules with the new `since` — existing ones keep applying. No recompile logic needed, just data.

rules.message: std.time.nanoTimestamp is removed from std.time in Zig 0.16.0.
rules.suggestion: Use x86_64 RDTSC inline asm, Windows QPC (RtlQueryPerformanceCounter), or std.time.epoch.

rules.message: std.time.milliTimestamp is removed from std.time in Zig 0.16.0.
rules.suggestion: Use x86_64 RDTSC inline asm or Windows QPC.
Use 'std.debug.print' for console, or 'std.Io.File.Writer.init(.stdout(), io, &buf)' with modern std.Io.

rules.message: std.mem.tokenize is deprecated in favor of explicit tokenizers.
